name: The Gyroid Reliquary
injected_by: opencode (space-bunny-free) — session gyroid-reliquary-2026-09-29. A Zone authored entirely in OntoMath, under the authority of Zach. No engine change was made to admit it: no new class, no new enum value, no new method.

displayName.v: The Reliquary's Own Light — breathing in the channels
The Heart's Radiance — gold, cooling to ember
The Labyrinth Medium — indigo fog, shadowed by the membrane itself

reliquary.occluderIs.v: the Membrane's own distance function, re-authored here so this medium's incident light is shadowed by the lattice. Marched by volumeSourceVisibility (SdfWgsl.cpp:3533-3555) via the emitted volumeSdfEval.

reliquary.correctionNote.v: An earlier version of this Zone recorded that volumeOccluder was never read by the WGSL volume transport, and left it unset. That was wrong: the JSON key maps to MediumBinding::occluderSdf and IS marched. The error was grepping SdfWgsl.cpp for the JSON key instead of the C++ member name. Corrected 2026-09-29.

displayName.v: The Shaft Beam — the Reliquary's only vertical
The Iris Halo — teal at 16 m, the Heart's complement
The Nimbus — weather on the far side of the Oculus

reliquary.lipschitzProof.v: |grad g| <= 2*sqrt(3)*k = 1.8138 <= 1.8338; the divisor is a proved lower bound on the true distance, not a tuning

reliquary.boundingNote.v: The gyroid is PERIODIC and the gyroid is a SOLID: it fills all of space, so the bare |g| = t surface is negative a long way from anywhere and a Reliquary built on it alone has no exterior to stand outside of. What gives this Zone a boundary is the authored ‖p‖ − 30.0 m term intersected into the expression, not the proxy AABB. Raising that radius is the one-number way to grow the Reliquary; fieldExtent (31.5 m) only follows it.

reliquary.doctrine.v: A Zone is a bound in a continuum. This one's bound is a surface that cannot be built, only evaluated.
